source_text: The incision depth and length mirror traditional forms but are precisely controlled to expose the urethral lumen while preserving erectile function, with healing accelerated by modern hygiene—typically 2-4 weeks—though long-term risks like stricture formation remain unaddressed by empirical medical endorsement, as the procedure lacks recognized therapeutic utility in contemporary urology.
